references.text: Here we also see that the Pharisees seek signs, which shows their doubt and lack of faith, similar to the situation in Mark.
Jesus warns against the hypocrisy of the Pharisees, which is relevant to their behavior in Mark where they test Jesus.
The Pharisees and others again test Jesus by seeking a sign, mirroring the event in Mark.
Here religious leaders challenge Jesus' authority, parallel to the actions of the Pharisees in Mark.
